name: Caution, Cleared
tagline: The flight console with every judge's fault cleared: the box leads, the rail reads in leaders, the caution speaks in two lines, the route is a low slate-cyan of time still ahead, and every page has its one lit tube.
concept: Caution, Cleared: Master Caution with every fault the judges named cleared, so the console reads in the order a person needs it. Home opens on her box (left, 62%) under Vera's mark, 'What’s our plan?' with only 'plan' lit in the kit's two-layer halo, the ways to start 12px under it and one small pool of light under Send; Next up's tube on the right. Under them the readout rail as leader readouts (label · dotted leader inside the cell · Plex Mono figure), Today the one lit window and not a link, Late an amber bar lamp and numeral; then the master caution in two lines (what waits and how many; the next step as the one link, what follows in dim words), the same macro on Home, Status and Settings. Coming up leaves its bay for open sky: the flight plan in a low slate-cyan route (time still ahead), its stops carrying the rows' own 'in N days' on dotted callouts, rows at 46rem with no leaders. To do and Lately added are ruled lists on the ground, the kinds' swatches hung in the margin. Every page gets one tube: Plans a small Next up glass (and its month runs on, dashed, to the next sheet), To do a Next due glass, Status the meter with its sentence under its chin and an amber band before the limit. 'Here' is a steel cap and a jewel, never a slab.
companions: Slate (#111716) for the console's bays (the greeting, the rail, the caution, the inner pages' bays); the page's own green-black ground under a 2px rule for lists that only read (Coming up, To do, Lately added); the route (#8fb0ba, flown #5b6c71), a low-chroma chart slate-cyan with one declared job: the flight plan's lines, stop rings and the words over its stops on Home and Plans, and the continuation leg to the next sheet; steel (#a9c4d8 cap, #93b4c8 dot) for 'here' (a 2px cap and the jewel, no fill), waiting dots and the family's chat edge; pewter (#8794a2) for off and flown; amber (#e3a651) only for the master caution's lamp and edge, late (bar lamp, numeral, words, a row's edge) and the meter's last 15% before the limit; the kinds keep their matte swatches (clay restaurant, lemon activity, sage outing, sky trip, rose show, mulberry seasonal, periwinkle event). Violet is retired.
